content: अर्ण {%a.%} [ऋ-न] .²1 Being in motion, agitated; restless .²2 Foaming, effervescing. .{@-र्णः@} .²1 A flood, stream; water (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .²2 The teak tree; <ls>Bhāg. 3. 15. 19</ls>. .²3 A letter (of the alphabet); पञ्चार्णो मनुरीरितः. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a metre having 10 feet and belonging to the class called Daṇḍaka .²5 Colour; श्रीह्रीविभूत्यात्मवदद्भुतार्णम् <ls>Bhāg. 2. 6. 44</ls>. (<ab>v. l.</ab>) .{@-र्णा@} A river (<ab>Ved.</ab>). .{@-र्णम्@} Tumult or din of battle, confused noise; नृमणा वींरपस्त्योऽर्णा धीरेव सनिता <ls>Rv. 5. 50. 4</ls>.
